language.title: Language
language.label: Editor language:
friendly.undefined_variable.title: This variable is not defined yet.
friendly.undefined_variable.help: Define it first, for example with <{name}> = 5, or check the spelling.
friendly.unknown_command.title: This command is not recognized.
friendly.unknown_command.help: Easy Math Lang commands start with *, for example *frac(2 ; 3). Check the spelling or pick a command from the symbol bar.
friendly.geometry_outside_draw.title: Geometry commands belong inside *draw(...).
friendly.geometry_outside_draw.help: Wrap the command in a *draw( ... ) block, for example *draw( *point(A = 0, 0) *line(A ; B) ).
friendly.unclosed_paren.title: A parenthesis is missing.
friendly.unclosed_paren.help: Check that every ( has a matching ). Add the missing ) at the end of the command.
friendly.unclosed_math.title: Inline math is not closed.
friendly.unclosed_math.help: Math starts and ends with a single backslash: \ x^2 \. Add the closing \.
friendly.unclosed_block.title: A block is not closed.
friendly.unclosed_block.help: End the block with a ) on its own line. Content after the opener is consumed until then.
friendly.empty_math.title: This math is empty.
friendly.empty_math.help: Put an expression between the backslashes, for example \ x^2 \.
friendly.calc_error.title: This calculation could not be evaluated.
friendly.calc_error.help: Use numbers, pi, e, or variables you defined above. Check names and operators in calc(...).
friendly.table_in_math.title: Tables cannot be used inside inline math.
friendly.table_shape.title: This table or matrix is not complete.
friendly.table_shape.help: Every row needs the same number of cells, and no cell may be empty.
friendly.geometry_error.title: This *draw figure could not be built.
friendly.geometry_error.help: Check point names and that the figure can be solved (for example it needs enough distances or points).
friendly.generic.title: Something is wrong here.
friendly.generic.help: Check the spelling of commands and that everything is defined before use. The technical message below has the details.

symbol.quad-sym.description: Quad space (1em, text and math) (*quad → quad)
symbol.calc.description: Evaluate a math expression (numbers, pi/e, and sin/sqrt/... functions).
symbol.int.description: Definite (*int(0 ; 1 ; x^2 ; x)) or indefinite (*int(x^2)) integral.
symbol.oint.description: Contour integral (Typst integral.cont). Same args as *int.
symbol.vec.description: Math-mode column vector (Typst vec). At least 2 components split on ; (or ,). Works inside \ ... \ math and *matrix cells.
symbol.diff.description: Derivative df/dx as a fraction; *diff(f ; x ; n) for the n-th.
symbol.pdiff.description: Partial derivative (Typst partial). Same args as *diff.
symbol.det.description: Determinant with vertical bars (Typst mat with | delimiters). Same rows/cells as *matrix, or *det(*matrix(...)).
symbol.set.description: Set-builder {x | condition} (two ;-args); one or 3+ args list {a, b, c}. Commas always list: *set(a, b).
symbol.table.description: Table. Rows split on |, cells on ; (comma works when no ;).
symbol.matrix.description: Matrix (Typst mat). Rows split on |, cells on ;.
symbol.cases.description: Piecewise / equation system (Typst cases). Rows split on |; multiline *cases( block works too.
symbol.align.description: Equations aligned at = (Typst &). Rows split on |; multiline *align( block works too.
symbol.var-def.description: Define a variable. Referenced later as <name>.
symbol.define.description: Define a reusable value. Also: *define x = 5, let x = 5.
symbol.draw-gallery.description: Draw gallery — browse every geometry command with a preview; insert an example or a single command.
symbol.draw-skeleton.description: Draw skeleton — a minimal valid draw block.
symbol.geo-line.description: Draw a segment from A to B.
symbol.geo-ray.description: Ray starting at A through B.
symbol.geo-equal-angle.description: Angle ABC equals angle DEF (solver constraint; both angles get the same arc + tick marks).
symbol.geo-arc.description: Arc around center from start to end (counterclockwise).
symbol.geo-label.description: Custom text label near a point.
symbol.geo-length.description: Show the measured length of AB.
symbol.geo-angle-value.description: Show the measured angle at B.
symbol.geo-midpoint.description: C is the midpoint of AB.
symbol.doc-title.description: Set the document title (centered heading + PDF metadata). Aliases: *doc-title, *doctitle, *title.
symbol.doc-font.description: Set the document font family and size (e.g. *doc_font(DejaVu Sans ; 14pt)). Aliases: *doc-font, *docfont.
symbol.raw-p.description: Print raw text, bypassing other rules.
symbol.bold.description: Bold text. Short alias: *b(...). Nesting, variables and calc() work inside.
symbol.newpage.description: Page break (Typst pagebreak). Alias: *pagebreak. Bare or *newpage().
symbol.image.description: Image from a file (width like 50% or 6cm). Relative paths resolve from the document folder.
